$description: Dark high-contrast theme semantic color tokens. Completes the accessibility matrix for users who need BOTH maximum contrast AND a dark surface (Windows High Contrast dark, macOS Increase Contrast + Dark Mode, prefers-contrast: more + prefers-color-scheme: dark). Near-black base with near-white text; text pairings target WCAG AAA (7:1+) and non-text UI (borders/focus) exceed 3:1 vs the base. Contrast ratios documented vs the #030712 base.

secondary.$description: Slightly lighter secondary surface (#111827) — clear separation from primary

elevated.$description: Elevated surface (#1F2937) with bright border for definition

primary.$description: Pure white primary text — 20.9:1 vs base (AAA)

disabled.$description: Medium gray disabled text (#9CA3AF) — 7.1:1 vs base (WCAG exempt for disabled)

inverse.$description: Near-black text for use on bright interactive surfaces

default.$description: Bright default border (#D1D5DB) — 12.9:1 vs base, far exceeds 3:1 UI contrast

focus.$description: Bright blue focus ring (#93C5FD) — 9.9:1 vs base, clearly visible

error.$description: Bright red error border (#F87171) — 6.0:1 vs base (exceeds 3:1 UI)

default.$description: Bright blue interactive (#93C5FD) — 9.9:1 vs base (AAA for text)

hover.$description: Lighter blue on hover (#BFDBFE) — 13.4:1 vs base

disabled.$description: Disabled interactive — WCAG exempt for disabled controls

positive.$description: Bright green positive (#4ADE80) — 11.6:1 vs base (AAA), used with icon+text

negative.$description: Bright red negative (#F87171) — 6.0:1 vs base, used with icon+text

warning.$description: Bright amber warning (#FBBF24) — 11.6:1 vs base, used with icon+text

pending.$description: Bright teal pending (#5EEAD4) — 13.7:1 vs base (AAA). Pair with icon + label.

neutral.$description: Bright gray neutral (#D1D5DB) — 12.9:1 vs base (AAA). Pair with label.

positiveSubtle.$description: Dark positive tint panel. Pair with status.positive (green.400) or text.primary (≥12:1, AA/AAA).

negativeSubtle.$description: Dark negative tint panel. Pair with status.negative (red.400) or text.primary.

warningSubtle.$description: Dark warning tint panel. Pair with status.warning (amber.400) or text.primary.

infoSubtle.$description: Dark info tint panel. Pair with status.info (blue.300) or text.primary.

pendingSubtle.$description: Dark pending pill panel. Pair with status.pending (teal.300) or text.primary.

neutralSubtle.$description: Dark neutral tint panel. Pair with text.primary (AA text).

positive.$description: Bright green for income — always paired with ↑ arrow icon

negative.$description: Bright red for expenses — always paired with ↓ arrow icon
